trip.title: 挪威峡湾与北极圈示例 / Norway Fjords & Arctic Demo
trip.subtitle: 匿名示例：铁路、峡湾自驾与北部公路旅行的组合，不代表实时可订状态。

flights.note: Verify the live timetable before booking

days.title: 奥斯陆至卑尔根 / Oslo to Bergen
days.overnight: 卑尔根市中心 / Bergen city centre
days.summary: Arrive in Norway and continue west by scenic railway, avoiding a separate city hotel change.

sights.name: 卑尔根铁路 / Bergen Railway
sights.description: A cross-country rail journey linking the capital region with the west coast.
sights.note: Leave a generous buffer after an international arrival.

days.booking: Reserve a flexible train departure after flight arrival.
days.fallback: If the flight is delayed, use the next protected or flexible rail option.

days.title: 卑尔根与弗洛姆 / Bergen and Flåm
days.transport: 步行 + 自驾 / Walking + self-drive
days.summary: A short Bergen morning followed by a scenic transfer to the inner fjord.

sights.name: 布吕根 / Bryggen
sights.description: Historic harbour frontage and compact old-town lanes.

sights.name: 斯泰格斯坦观景台 / Stegastein Viewpoint
sights.note: The approach road is narrow; check conditions.

days.booking: Collect the vehicle after the city walk.
days.fallback: Skip the high viewpoint in poor visibility.

days.title: 纳柔依峡湾与55号公路 / Nærøyfjord and Route 55
days.transport: 游船 + 接驳 + 自驾 / Cruise + shuttle + self-drive
days.summary: Experience the narrow fjord first, then begin the mountain-road crossing without backtracking.

sights.name: 纳柔依峡湾 / Nærøyfjord
sights.description: A narrow UNESCO-listed fjord arm with steep mountain walls.
sights.note: Book the boat and return transfer as one timed chain.

sights.name: 松恩山路55号 / Sognefjellet Route 55
sights.description: High-mountain scenic road linking the fjord region with Lom.
sights.note: Seasonal access can change; verify with the road authority.

days.booking: Reserve the fjord cruise and coordinated shuttle.
days.fallback: Use the lower all-season route if the mountain road closes.

days.title: 盖朗厄尔峡湾至洛恩 / Geirangerfjord to Loen
days.summary: A full scenic day around Geiranger with a westward finish in Loen.

sights.name: 盖朗厄尔峡湾 / Geirangerfjord
sights.description: Classic fjord scenery with waterfalls and steep-sided viewpoints.
sights.note: Allow time for slow traffic and photo stops.

sights.name: 老鹰之路观景台 / Ørnesvingen Viewpoint

days.booking: No timed activity in the base plan.
days.fallback: Prioritise lower viewpoints if cloud obscures the mountain roads.

days.title: 冰川地区返回卑尔根 / Glacier region to Bergen
days.overnight: 卑尔根机场区域 / Bergen Airport area
days.summary: Visit an accessible arm of Jostedalsbreen before the final west-coast drive.

sights.name: 约斯特谷冰原 / Jostedalsbreen
sights.description: Mainland Europe's largest ice cap, experienced from a safe public approach.
sights.note: Never walk onto glacier ice without a qualified guide.

days.fallback: Use a glacier museum or shorter valley walk in severe weather.

days.title: 埃沃内斯至斯沃尔韦尔 / Evenes to Svolvær
days.transport: 航班 + 自驾 / Flight + self-drive
days.summary: Fly north, collect a vehicle, and use a light first day for eastern Lofoten.

sights.name: 亨宁斯韦尔 / Henningsvær
sights.description: Fishing village spread across small islands.
sights.note: Use marked parking; do not obstruct local roads.

days.booking: Coordinate flight arrival and rental opening hours.
days.fallback: Drive directly to Svolvær if the flight is delayed.

days.title: 罗弗敦E10公路 / Lofoten E10 Road
days.summary: A westbound E10 day with beaches and fishing villages, ending centrally to reduce the next day's drive.

sights.name: 豪克兰海滩 / Haukland Beach
sights.description: Pale sand and mountain scenery on Vestvågøy.

sights.name: 雷讷 / Reine
sights.description: Iconic fishing-village setting in western Lofoten.
sights.note: Keep the schedule flexible for wind and rain.

days.booking: Stay near Leknes for route efficiency.
days.fallback: Shorten the western loop and prioritise Haukland.

days.title: 罗弗敦至比耶克维克 / Lofoten to Bjerkvik
days.summary: Keep the morning flexible, then divide the transfer toward Senja into a comfortable first stage.

sights.name: E10国家景观公路 / E10 National Scenic Route
sights.description: Return east through changing coastal and mountain scenery.
sights.note: This is a transfer day; avoid adding a long hike.

days.fallback: Stop earlier near Evenes if conditions deteriorate.
